bays.restriction: Controlled parking zone — pay by phone or permit parking in marked bays
bays.times: Monday to Friday, 10am to 12 noon; parking is free outside CPZ hours and on bank holidays
bays.tariff: On-street parking £2.60 per hour (Haringey medium usage area); a 30% surcharge applies for diesel vehicles
bays.pay: RingGo (app, website, text or automated phone call) in pay-by-phone bays; resident and visitor permits in permit bays
